WeatherReports.ApiKeyDescription: Optional. Leave empty (recommended) to get the weather through Matomo with the WeatherAPI key saved in the WeatherReports plugin settings, the key is then not visible in your website code. When set, the browser calls WeatherAPI directly with this key.
WeatherReports.ApiKeySettingDescription: Used by the Weather tag of Matomo Tag Manager when the tag has no API key of its own, through the index.php?module=WeatherReports&action=getWeather endpoint. The key stays on the server. Get a free key on https://www.weatherapi.com/
WeatherReports.ConditionDescription: Weather conditions (sunny, cloudy, rainy, etc.) during visits
WeatherReports.FeltTemperatureDescription: Perceived temperature (heat index or wind chill) during visits
WeatherReports.LanguageDescription: Language of the weather condition sent to Matomo. Reports and the visitor log display conditions in the language of each Matomo user.
WeatherReports.MatomoUrlDescription: URL of this Matomo, used to get the weather when no API key is set in the tag.
WeatherReports.PrecipitationDescription: Rainfall or snowfall amount during visits
WeatherReports.PrecipitationUnitDescription: Millimeters or Inches. Values sent by the Weather tag are converted to this unit.
WeatherReports.PressureUnitDescription: Millibars or Inches of mercury. Values sent by the Weather tag are converted to this unit.
WeatherReports.TemperatureUnitDescription: Celsius or Fahrenheit. Values sent by the Weather tag are converted to this unit.
WeatherReports.VisibilityUnitDescription: Kilometers or Miles. Values sent by the Weather tag are converted to this unit.
WeatherReports.WeatherTagDescription: Get weather informations from your visitors.
WeatherReports.WindDirectionDescription: Wind direction (N, S, E, W, etc.) during visits
WeatherReports.WindSpeedUnitDescription: Kilometers per hour or Miles per hour. Values sent by the Weather tag are converted to this unit.
